bars.says: The player can distinguish black etched relief, usable ground, living illumination and heated-room clear-air edges while the Dark dims terrain, buildings and non-colony creatures without removing their silhouettes or obscuring the colony's pawns.

meant.intent: The compose line and frozen sheet require inhabitable, visually readable country. This carries the protection/nearby-terror clause through reduced visual detail and partially expresses the beauty clause through briefly revealed relief; it does not carry beauty turning into nightmares or the source-of-nightmares dread, which are deferred with cryptid content.
meant.source: CASE Biomes.compose.json line; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/abyss.md sections 1, 5 and 9; delegated: require usable local ground and a spatial boundary to make the material-air description playable; owner Abyss experience in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; delegated: dimming with retained silhouettes, rather than sprite removal, preserves readable danger under the standing no-unreadable-vanishing ruling.

accept: From a heated room, an open doorway shows clear indoor air against the Dark outside; black etched crags stand above a dark-sand route, and living plants light nearby ground while the workshop remains findable.

Unveiling reveals the explored etched country in detail; returning ambient Dark reduces that detail and dims buildings and a wild predator, but their silhouettes, the colony's pawns and maintained nearby light remain readable.
reject: A flat black sand map and a uniformly dark sky contain all the named terrain labels but no etched standing relief or local air boundary.
Fog art hides the selected worker and controls as completely as the distant country.
A predator in the Dark is drawn exactly as in clear air, or disappears entirely instead of retaining a dim silhouette.
bars.lazy: none: the words require relief, usable ground, heated-room boundaries and density-dependent dimming with retained silhouettes; a uniform sky tint, unchanged predator or culled sprite fails.

bars.says: Across a complete season of ordinary full-map play the colony can keep warm lit work and farms usable amid recurring Dark, native predation and grain wear, without runaway residue, emptied native life, stalled work or cascading errors after reload or reordered work.

meant.intent: The first version must run as a whole: protection, living light, nearby danger and material maintenance must coexist over time, not only in isolated forced scenes. It carries sustained refuge and nearby ordinary predation, not the deferred beauty-to-nightmare reversal or long-stay discovery of a nightmare source; erosion is a material cost, not that dread.
meant.source: Owner 2026-10-20 Abyss experience in biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; cleanse whole-bar requirement; delegated: classify flood/desert/stall/error outcomes using actual colony/material/ecology trajectories.

figurative.stands_for: Residue accumulates faster than ordinary hauling, storage and refining can use or manage it during maintained play.
figurative.accept: Residue rises after exposed work, then ordinary hauling and refining bring the backlog under control; no stack moves by itself.

figurative.stands_for: Exceptions repeat or spread to other consumers after a fault instead of ordinary play resuming.
figurative.accept: A mid-cycle reload resumes warming, planting and hauling with a clean log; no literal cascade is required.

accept: During routine residence, workers roof and heat a refuge, maintain a living-light farm, handle a local feeder failure and use recovered grain; native life continues and the explored country periodically clears and closes.

A save made during active light/air/material pressure resumes into the same kind of recoverable routine; planting before heating and heating before planting both reach usable work when their ordinary prerequisites are met.
reject: A staged clearing with fire, predation or grain switched off looks successful, but full default play empties the native food chain or eats the colony’s land.
Residue fills paths and storage without useful cost, light failures require continual bespoke intervention, ordinary work cannot resume, or a mid-cycle reload starts repeated exceptions.
The main work sequence succeeds only in its scripted order because warming, planting or excluding a feeder leaves stale state in another system.
bars.lazy: none: the words require complete default natural operation across the full stated stretch and action-order/reload cases, excluding an isolated forced showcase.

RM standalone and full campaign neighbour defaults. Save halfway through active cycle; repeat the main heat/roof/plant/haul/refine/exclude-feeder actions in a second order. Continue representative worst regimes to day 100. No forced clear sky or forced recurrence substitutes for actual natural cycles; if natural Unveiling is absent, extend observation through its natural occurrence and return.
range.left_out: No effortless guaranteed survival for deliberately unheated farms, hostile unrelated raid schedules or unbounded custom map sizes beyond the loaded supported configuration. No expectation of exact trajectory equality for stochastic runs, or unchanged unscribed feeder dimming immediately after reload. Next-version extras are excluded by shipped defaults, not selectively disabled only for the test.

sees.instrument: M2 whole-map model after calibration, complete state/flow/cause log and bounded live look/listen across B1/B7 cases on actual default maps (T37A). Model predictions select worst regimes; live natural whole runs confirm them.
sees.start: Full map with real native population, ordinary imported startup supplies, all kept unlocks available, no pending developer jobs/forced weather/cheat nutrition; explicit settings hash. Use a recorded mid-cycle save and a matched start snapshot for alternate orders.
sees.on: All kept mechanics at shipped defaults, including Dark, Unveiling, erosion, lamp crops, native feeding/aversion/warnings, gust soundscape and muffle; every kept unlock available. Next-version extras off. All DLC. Both RM-only resolved content and the campaign with declared neighbour defaults where range names them.
sees.control: Artificial stock injections, locked mechanics, disabled hazards or compressed tick omissions could fake stability: audit settings and resource/event sources, allow no developer grants, keep all growth/temperature/AI/erosion/light/audio scheduling active. Compression may accelerate wall-clock only by executing the ordinary ticks; it must preserve RNG ordering, needs, temperatures, jobs, weather and save state. Natural trajectories and intermediate checkpoints rule out endpoint-only abundance.
sees.reset: Use copied input snapshots/disposable local maps. Restore settings snapshot and remove fixture-owned objects/effects only, or discard the map after save comparison; never alter the fixed world or canonical saves. Replay restores kernel state and RNG inputs, not an assumed clean map.
sees.live_only_why: Calibrated models identify runaway regimes, but the complete visible country and audible warning mix across an actual natural season cannot be established by a table or isolated state trace.

tests.reject: Owner would reject if false: refuge, living light, nearby ordinary danger and material maintenance must coexist over a full season; isolated forced scenes cannot establish that.
tests.renormalize: No yield, speed, dimensions, market value, tuning percentage or variant count is fixed by says or pictures; the same comparison survives retuning/art variants.
tests.first_version: Land, ordinary life or the single Dark/light/fuel signature as classified in census.json; necessary presentation/warning deletion arguments are recorded there.

checks.what: Resolved RM_Abyss weather table/durations/commonalities, native species/plant entries and positive animalDensity; XML shorthand parsed as elements. These counts/numbers are ours, not acceptance bars.
RM_DarkKernel temperature transition constants, murk step/floor, lamp minimum and update intervals recorded with fingerprints; renormalizable tuning only.
Actual plant glow/overlight, growth temperature/light/fertility/substrate rules, harvest item/product fields and inherited giant-stalk fields resolved in RM and campaign tiers.

Existing validation.py static/lint, Utils/selftest_abyss_lint.py planted breaks and actual compiled source inclusion remain regression checks; obsolete required-extra checks are scoped to opt-in settings.
AbyssFuzz production-kernel action tests and mutation suite remain checks, including deferred kernel tests; a green unit row never proves a player bar.
BroodSelfTest and Utils/selftest_abyss_brood*.py retained for dormant expedition; their finite-life-stage assumption cannot certify continuous growth.

Every settings field initializer, Scribe default, reset snapshot, composed default and next-version gate agree; worldgen UI/scoring inert. Muffle/deepfire owner defaults preserved. Outdoor noise pockets default off; absent halo/release effects are not required to be built to audit their absence.
MaxFlightTime/FlightCooldown/race flags/frame binding plus Pawn_FlightTracker state are recorded for krizzak; no art-frame count in a bar.
Dark and krizzak LightLedger owner shares, overlight-grid refresh and clear/recovery identities are logged independently.
Erodible material categories, damage/tries/dust/refinery constants and grain multiplier recorded; roof cell/footprint resolution inspected; no ExplosiveGrowth water input.
Gust hysteresis/cooldown/feed nutrition and sound-event scheduling/cutoff constants recorded; unforced input trace distinguishes detection from actual wind.
Native kill/down/despawn/corpse causes, map-exit murk removal, warning job identity/order recorded with game/save hashes.
Pursuit timer consumer ShadowMultiplier and scanner banded payload resolved under actual campaign load; unused dynamic cover API never counts as consumer evidence.
Texture paths/facing bindings/ruled variants and footprint/affordance values checked separately from land readability; world swirls belong to BiomesShell.
M1–M4 calibration records identify untrusted regions, input hashes, numeric error budgets, controlled mutations and all kept default settings; no model result labelled a game measurement.

rules.rule: Outdoor ambient Dark density follows the map's shared ordinary outdoor temperature; each room's density follows that room's ordinary temperature. Unveiling clears ambient particles, not solar geometry. Outdoor drifting noise pockets, fold lanes, phantom clearance and carried halos are next-version extras, off; no outdoor microclimate is promised.

Use a common bounded final density for view, targeting and sensory consumers; clear endpoints do not bypass intervening Dark. Existing normal wall occlusion remains. Local warmth removes Dark-caused aim loss, not unrelated storm/injury penalties. Presentation uses density-scaled detail/contrast loss for terrain/buildings and non-colony creatures with retained silhouettes; player-owned colonists, tame animals and mechs stay fully drawn, and selection/inspect/UI/warnings remain readable. Ordinary unexplored fog is unchanged.

Living emitters resist ambient Dark; building glowers shrink by their named ledger contribution. Deepfire retains its ruled ambient exemption. Each owner restores only its own share, including useful overlight.

Light feeding requires actual local access and an unobstructed path to the emitter; heat/tame/downed/dead/despawned gates stop feeding. Ishvarith flees only with reachable darkness; no invulnerability wall is promised.
One actual wind/gust history drives gharrek state and land sound. Detector output cannot substitute for generating/observing intermittent real wind; no turbine echo returns.

Grain samples exposed eligible material: unroofed natural rock and steel-stuff edifices, not water or pawn acid. Roofs protect. Destruction creates actual hollow substrate; tholin uses normal haul/refinery/fuel actions. Current stochastic grain multiplier is an abstraction, not atmospheric mass conservation.

Placed map sound muffling samples local Dark at the camera listener; UI and other maps remain untouched. Warning text remains independent of muffling, and no natural event is proved by a forced proof hook.

Observe ordinary tick scheduling through save/load and alternate action orders. Existing unscribed krizzak light-share safe-reset is permitted; ambient and other shares reapply independently. Murk clears on leaving an Abyss-held map.

Existing static pursuit-shadow and banded acoustic-scanner consumers stay dependencies; no active cover, exact sensing or new raid engine. Existing Taozin roster/nest and ordinary Wreckage/Bones integrations remain, with no roster evictions.

Every deferred feature ships behind a labelled next-version off parent and child gates; code/defs remain loadable, menu/job/letter/incident effects absent. All-off is playable ordinary land/life/weather. Built references do not establish player-facing necessity.

No worldgen in any version, no tile authoring, no new heat/sun rule, all DLC assumed and naming tiers respected. Native growth/forage and local build ground use actual resolved ordinary roles; zero owned tiles is expected.

meetings.why: Building, vegetation and grain share actual exposed ground: their combination can erase the relief or legal fungus substrate while increasing harvest/light. Static terrain compatibility does not settle a season of erosion. M2 tests the whole land/food/material group.

Room temperature, shared outdoor temperature, ambient weather, target obstruction, visible boundary and listener muffling all consume this field. Outdoor uniformity is settled by R1, not an unknown. Clear endpoints may still bypass an intervening Dark segment or disagree with lamp/light/audio updates; the entire retained consumer group needs M3 calibration. No carried-halo or outdoor-pocket implementation is required.
meetings.model: M3: Dark geometry, optical paths and composition sweep

meetings.why: Dark shrink, protected biological emitters, krizzak bite/recovery, overlight and aversion form a three-way feedback: reduced useful light can admit predators which remove caretakers, preventing light recovery. Ledger arithmetic alone cannot show actual overlight or path integration. M3 gives local consistency; M2 carries its calibrated result into season recovery.
meetings.model: M3: Dark geometry, optical paths and composition sweep

meetings.why: Terrain, relief and buildings lose detail with density; non-colony creatures retain dim silhouettes while colony pawns, controls and warning text remain readable. These visual channels and listener-local muffling share the declared air state without requiring sprite culling or silent attacks. Unveiling clears all first-version Dark; no carried knot survives it. Live sorting/listening remains necessary.

Unveiling recurrence, Witchfire wind/ordinary fires, actual stillness, gust detector hysteresis, gharrek nutrition and audio timing share the same clock. A persistent storm wind may trigger a cosmetic pulse yet starve later feeders or drown warning contrast. M4 must check all states jointly, then feed M2.
meetings.model: M4: Wind, weather, feeding and cue timing walk

meetings.why: Save/reload, transient ledger ownership, room/outdoor density refresh, crop/prey recovery, erosion and routine labor meet across a season. A safe light reset may rescue a bad economy during every reload while stale jobs accumulate after reordered actions; local tests cannot exclude that. M2 compares intermediates, alternate orders and unforced continuation.

Diet/locomotion/ordinary attack are retained; special expedition behavior is gated before side effects, without removing species. Dead/downed/despawned animals stop feeding ownership; a corpse/exit sign remains. Murk is air, so map exit removes it. These disjoint lifecycle cases permit every touching bar; M1 must still verify each implementation transition.

Local material obstruction and ambiguous scanner readings cannot produce exact targeting; static campaign pursuit delay changes search time without granting invulnerability or requiring the deferred cover meter. RM lacks the scenario search dependency but keeps local shelter; campaign adds the existing real timer consumer. Radio trade is not orbital optical localization. No rule requires an extra-generated target to populate the scanner.

Wind feeds gharreks/prey, cultivated light feeds colonists, native predators consume stock and grain/fungus can alter productivity. Native utility, Taozin, ordinary breeding and feeding losses can agree locally yet jointly empty prey or multiply labor. M2 couples all of them, including both colony scales.

Roof choice changes damage, tholin input, hollow habitat and heating capacity together. More grain can fuel more warmth while opening more exposed work and shifting the food base, or consume its own source. Neither material selectivity nor local harvest alone settles that feedback; M2 measures calibrated trajectories.

Defaults compose by parent gates: neutral lane/phantom/cover APIs cannot reactivate their off owners; settings all-off cleans each share without deleting definitions or pawns. Static pursuit/banded payload/native roster are independent retained dependencies, so no accepting scene requires an off extra. M1 audits all parent/child transitions and imported settings to falsify this separation.
